title: Extract reusable feature contracts and examples
description: Establish RPG, MMO and skill-system source packages, neutral inventory example, canonical native contract packages and generators. Keep game-specific providers, catalogs and integrations outside this repository.
acceptance_criteria: Public names, versions, descriptors, fingerprints and generated C# remain unchanged. Independent typechecks, mock/provider tests, generation drift and dependency checks pass. Native libraries and neutral providers compile/run without an engine or game checkout. Inventory remains example-only. Fresh consumer resolves all declared dependencies. No private consumer identifiers in code, records, history or commit messages.
notes: Reusable RPG/MMO/skill packages and example inventory are independent. Canonical generated C# belongs to three UPM Runtime packages; standalone projects compile the same files and preserved GUIDs. Public names/versions, 14 production and two example feature identities, five descriptor JSONs and generated C# remain stable. Ten typechecks, 44 feature tests, three Node checks, native providers, frozen external source consumer and clean exported checkout checks pass. Import verifier covers 175 files, 91 GUIDs and eight packages. No consumer identifiers or source history imported. Evidence: docs/verification/game-features.json; guide: docs/game-features.md. New Unity packages have structural/standalone verification, not Editor or rendered acceptance.

title: Ship reusable game feature libraries
description: Provide engine-independent RPG, MMO and skill-system contracts, mocks, generators, native interfaces and neutral examples with independent development tooling.
acceptance_criteria: Public contract identities and generated wire formats remain stable. Standalone and Unity package consumers use canonical native contracts. Neutral provider tests and an independent workspace validate declared dependencies. Repository tooling and tracker remain self-contained.
notes: Both scoped tasks completed: pinned mise tooling and independent Bees tracking, reusable feature definitions/mocks/generators/native contracts and neutral inventory example. Portable provider and fresh checkout validation pass. Release packaging, feeds and rendered engine integration are not part of this source-library milestone.

title: Configure mise and repository task tracking
description: Pin Bun, Node and Bees in repository mise configuration, add portable runner tasks, initialize the capsule tracker and document contributor commands.
acceptance_criteria: mise tasks validate succeeds; pinned tools and Bees resolve in this checkout. Tracker uses capsule identifiers and excludes SQLite runtime state from Git. Frozen dependency installation and representative mise tasks run. No private consumer names or machine paths in tracked configuration or records.
notes: Pinned Bun 1.3.6, Node 25.6.1 and Bees 0.4.0. Initialized capsule-prefix tracker and ignored local SQLite state. Nine mise task definitions validate; frozen install, six workspace typechecks and JavaScript quality pass through mise. Contributor commands and tracker/commit conventions documented.
